## Corresponding assets

- **Bricolage Grotesque:** `../neonplan/custom_components/neonplan3d/frontend/fonts/bricolage-grotesque.woff2`. Notice SHA-256: `4b5a7d8f37f5602621c8a8d7358a6a2e71317e6c231c661e15aef0275d3e07ba`.
- **Figtree:** `../neonplan/custom_components/neonplan3d/frontend/fonts/figtree.woff2`. Notice SHA-256: `140d37233e7f3ce7313798befa9600893bcceaf41a55fa0fa5ad52f7f657a268`.
- **Lit:** `NeonPlan prebuilt frontend JavaScript bundles`. Notice SHA-256: `c94b94b40b85a5083dea825ae844b1cedb40dd425685362c135e143265dd6cd4`.

Bricolage Grotesque and Figtree use SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their notices name the upstream projects [ateliertriay/bricolage](https://github.com/ateliertriay/bricolage) and [erikdkennedy/figtree](https://github.com/erikdkennedy/figtree). Lit uses BSD 3-Clause; it is a dependency of the pinned NeonPlan frontend (`vendor/neonplan/frontend/package.json`).

The existing Three.js MIT notice, NeonPlan MIT notice, and voluptuous BSD notice remain beside their corresponding vendored components. These notices do not license the application or the household data.
